headline: The decision may be easier than maintaining it
body:
Monday begins with the Moon in Aries, and the impatience may be enough to move a conversation, application, purchase, or decision that has been sitting in discussion. Before treating delay as rejection, check whether the answer is actually missing or whether no one has agreed who carries the next step.

By Wednesday, the Last Quarter Moon in Taurus makes the practical cost harder to ignore. The decision may be possible, but the schedule, budget, or division of labor does not work yet. If everyone agreed and one person is still expected to absorb the extra responsibility, the agreement is not finished.

Venus enters Libra on Thursday, followed by the Sun trine Saturn. A vague promise can become a fairer arrangement now. Name the deadline. Clarify who is paying. Divide the work before resentment becomes part of the agreement. When Mercury enters Leo on Sunday, say the part that needs recognition and put the revised terms where everyone can see them. Keep the idea if it still matters. Replace the version that no one can maintain.
